hits.video_tip: video_tip: 9:16, 12-15s. Second 0: macro shot of a single red rose pushing up through grey ash, petals igniting at the edges. Final beat: he offers the burning rose, her tear lands on it and it turns whole again.

patterns: Seedance 2.5 named in 13 of 24 video hits (Dreamina / Picsart / Flova); Kling 4.0 once; Grok Imagine in zero hits = open lane
Hook: "This AI video is (truly) a masterpiece 🔥" + 1 short line (lexx_aura 1.63M, 41K; kingofdairyque 12K)
Third-person micro-story logline: "She raised it in secret...", "A girl watches the last rose fade...", "She stood up when everyone else stood back."
Genre triplet tagline: "Dark Fantasy • Forbidden Bond • Hidden Truth"
Tool credit line on its own: "Made with Seedance 2.5" / "Made with AI Video on @Picsart"
Prompt CTA: "Try this prompt", "Prompt 👇", "The prompt is in the comments 👇", "Comment PICSARTAI for the prompt"
Halloween week: "Trick or treat 🎃", fog, haunted, nightmare (Oct 31 is Saturday)
Short wins: top video captions 70-115 chars; story captions ~270 chars; 0-1 hashtags (#PicsartPartner only)
Posting window: the big video hits landed 09:50-16:30 Amsterdam (Tue-Sun); Patrick posts 05:45-08:50 or ~19:20
Format: 12 of 24 video hits are 9:16 (8-30s, story ones ~15s); the 1.6M outlier is a 4.6 min 16:9 Halloween film
virals_narrative: Outside the watchlist (last ~48h) the AI-video meta is Halloween plus 'dark fantasy' micro-stories: a dragon-mother logline ('She hid 3 dragon babies... but he was already at the door', 85K) was copied by at least five accounts in one day, Halloween dance clips made with Flova hit 30-43K, and Grok Imagine posts are getting attention for its built-in music ('Grok Imagine generated the perfect music for this Halloween comedy'), but none broke 1K yet. Read: a gap for a Grok Imagine dark-fantasy creator who uses the proven logline + genre-triplet + prompt-CTA frame.

drafts.title: THE CROW-CROWNED WITCH
drafts.text:
She fed the crows for seven winters. On the eighth, they crowned her. 🐦‍⬛👑

Dark Fantasy • Crow Queen • Halloween Week

🖤 THE CROW-CROWNED WITCH 🖤

Seven winters long she shared her bread
with every crow the cold left dead.
Now black wings rise to guard her throne,
the night she fed is now her own.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
The prompt is in the comments 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10-15s. Second 0: extreme close-up of her closed eyes in falling snow, a crow lands on her shoulder and her eyes snap open (glowing amber). Then pull back: hundreds of crows lift off a moonlit graveyard and swirl into a crown of black feathers above her head. Cold blue moonlight, one warm candle. Last frame she stares into camera so it loops. Pin the full Grok Imagine prompt as your first reply.

drafts.title: THE PUMPKIN WIDOW
drafts.text:
Trick or treat... but she only takes souls. 🎃🩸

This one came out darker than I planned 🔥

🕯️ THE PUMPKIN WIDOW 🕯️

She carves a grin in every gourd
and lights it with a stolen word.
Knock twice, child, and you stay for good,
one more lantern in her wood.

Made with Grok Imagine
Comment WIDOW and I'll reply with the prompt 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 8-12s. Second 0: a small gloved hand knocks on a rotting door (use the knock as the audio hook). Door creaks open on the widow in a black veil holding a jack-o'-lantern whose carved face blinks. Cut to a foggy forest path lined with lanterns, each with a faint trapped face. Orange and black palette, heavy fog. Let Grok Imagine generate eerie music; end on the widow blowing out a candle (hard cut to black = loop).

drafts.title: THE LAST ROSE OF THE ASH KNIGHT
drafts.text:
She gave her last rose to a dying knight. A hundred years later, the rose came back for her. 🥀

Dark Fantasy • Undying Vow • Ashes & Thorns

🖤 THE LAST ROSE OF THE ASH KNIGHT 🖤

She laid the rose on armor cold,
a gift of love, a debt of old.
Now thorns of fire split the stone,
he rides from ash to bring her home.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Try this prompt for your own dark fantasy story 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 12-15s. Second 0: macro shot of a single red rose pushing up through grey ash, petals igniting at the edges. Then a knight in charred armor rises from the ash, embers falling off him, and walks toward a ruined tower where she waits by a candle-lit window. Desaturated greys with the rose as the only red. Final beat: he offers the burning rose, her tear lands on it and it turns whole again.
